page.overview:
What is Jake and the Never Land Pirates?

Jake and the Never Land Pirates is a licensed Disney Jr. DUPLO sub-theme, based on the Disney Junior television show of the same name, introduced in 2013. Three sets and four DUPLO Figures were released in the theme.

The theme features bright and colourful DUPLO bricks, mainly being Yellow, Red, Aqua, Lime Green and Dark Green. Each set includes several 2x2 bricks, two flowers and a gold doubloon (which is a new mould). The gold doubloon is rounded at the top and rectangular at the very bottom, it is gold and printed with a skull and two bones in the shape of an X and leaves surrounding it. The piece can be connected to regular DUPLO bricks.

Each set includes some island of some sort, usually were the gold doubloon is hidden. The islands are mostly green, and contain various plants. The other colours used with the island are aqua, transparent blue and yellow, giving the appearance of water and sand.

The theme includes several new printed pieces, including the gold doubloon (a rounded brick), a white flag with a skull and two bones in the shape of an X, a brown 1x2 with the printing of a tiki face, a light brown coconut on a red 1x2, and lastly Skully the parrot who is printed on an aqua 1x2 brick.
